notes: The historical main training circuit retains the narrow northern teardrop, central western return and inner hairpin, long parallel southwestern legs and southern U-turn. Independent anonymous public OSM GPS spatial samples corroborate the main-course pavement location in the January 5, 2026 Sentinel-2 raster and distinguish it from the unrelated northern training pad and larger western skidpan branches. The unordered points are not reconstructed as a driving trip. The earlier rejected outlines selected the wrong western and northern pavement; those outlines remain excluded. Native 10 m imagery and unverified GPS accuracy leave fine corner radii and historical alignment draft. All pixel vertices come from this independently georeferenced public raster; no supplied diagram is digitized or georeferenced. The 2016 organizer sprint uses additional skidpan branches and is not substituted for the supplied main-track configuration. Public GPS mapping points support course-branch identification only; no GPS coordinates are imported or redistributed. Identification inspection metadata: public-gps-identification-review.json, SHA-256 78fdf59abeeb70cd6cfad19487c0be4a0f8f65cb01cd797d870b50546341bc40. Geometry is independently digitized from the licensed georeferenced raster, not from the GPS samples. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1524.9 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 44 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
